source.identity: Sonic — Sonic Advance 2 — Game Boy Advance — Playable Characters

history.defect: The first right-foot brake was present, but K02→K03 let the pelvis pass only about one column beyond the support, so the core support-moment-arm reversal read too weakly and risked becoming metadata.
history.correction: Mutate SAME Locomotion017 K02–K04: hold the right support world-locked at x=31, establish the catch with pelvis visibly behind it, then drive pelvis/chest/head three columns beyond it before the left cross probe; sharpen counterlean and preserve nonuniform spacing.

history.basis: Fresh inspection of the actual 33-frame final render: K01 opens a wide right probe; K02 catches with pelvis clearly behind the fixed right foot; K03 carries pelvis/chest/head beyond that world-locked support while counterlean flips; K04 crosses the left probe before old support releases; K05 compresses into the left catch; K06 holds the brake; K07-K09 rebound with smaller spacing and secondary upper-body lag; K10's left countercatch is the only authored root-direction reversal; K11-K12 settle at a displaced asymmetric ready. No support teleport, equal spacing, straight root tween, phase reset, reverse-playback recovery, or idle reset survives.

noodle_queen.basis: The wide outside probe, pelvis-over-support pass, ugly crossed catch, deep counterlean compression, small rebound, upper-body overshoot and tiny support-caused countercatch form a specific lateral-braking sentence. The mechanism is visible in silhouette/support relation rather than living only in labels, and the finish keeps displaced crossover debt.
